name: Gasthaus Steinberg
kurzbeschreibung:
**Welcome to Gasthaus Steinberg in Westendorf**

Nestled in the heart of the **Tirol** Alps, **Gasthaus Steinberg** in **Westendorf** invites you to experience authentic Tyrolean hospitality in a cozy mountain setting. Just a short drive from **Innsbruck**, this charming guesthouse offers a perfect retreat for nature lovers, hikers, and those seeking relaxation amidst breathtaking alpine scenery.

Indulge in traditional Tyrolean cuisine, where every dish is crafted with local ingredients. Savor the fluffy layers of **Kaiserschmarrn**, melt in your mouth **Speckknödel**, or enjoy a hearty **Tiroler Gröstl**—each bite is a celebration of regional flavors. Pair your meal with a glass of crisp **Tiroler Bier** or a smooth **Grauburgunder** from the nearby vineyards.

After a day of exploring the stunning **Zillertal** Valley, unwind in our rustic yet comfortable rooms, each adorned with wooden beams and Tyrolean charm. Whether you're planning a hike to the **Ahornspitze**, a visit to the **Erlebnisbad Zillertal**, or simply soaking in the views from our terrace, **Gasthaus Steinberg** promises an unforgettable stay in the heart of the Alps.

Come and discover why **Westendorf** is a hidden gem in **Tirol**—where warm hospitality meets the magic of the mountains.
